summary: At the run boundary, with all obligations disposed and no pending work, this last small step puts the recorded non-monotonic installSnapshot reasoning on exact source ranges and states its applicability in terms of the default configuration. Submission is a feedback-only research product (no map version) adding two sources: S-compact-trailing (snapshot.go 216-247) and S-default-config (config.go 316-330). Cited reading: compactLogsWithTrailing returns without deleting anything when lastLogIdx <= trailingLogs and otherwise deletes only [FirstIndex, min(snapIdx, lastLogIdx-trailing)], so the store's last index is never reduced below the watermark; installSnapshot reaches it through compactLogs(req.LastLogIndex) on the non-monotonic branch, whereas the monotonic branch calls removeOldLogs with trailingLogs zero and clears the log entirely. DefaultConfig sets TrailingLogs to 10240, so with the default any node whose log holds at most 10240 entries performs no compaction at all during an install and the watermark keeps naming a retained entry, which is why the confirmed mismatch measured by check 58ebdb2f92184614b01ecfab56fe2bc9 belongs to the log-clearing branch rather than to compaction in general. The remaining list keeps the one unexercised non-monotonic shape (an install with TrailingLogs small relative to the log length and a snapshot index below the watermark) plus the other recorded open items (the composed store-failure-plus-compaction history argued but not executed, the malformed-entry panic lead with no witness and reachability outside the crash-stop fault model, and the transport reading not evaluated for defects). Nothing about the run's confirmed results changes: three confirmed in-scope violations and one reviewed bounded no-violation against map v4, with no pending work and no open review issues. Preflight validation returns valid with no diagnostics.
